body.x: The world’s largest IT electronics exhibition, ‘CES 2018 Media Day (Consumer Technology Show’ have greeted its second day on 7th (local time) in Las Vegas, United States.
(Photo Description: Samsung doing demos of smart TV in real time at the press conference)

Samsung unveiled their new various lineups including Micro LED TVs and Flip at the press conference. Micro LED TV is the world’s first product to be launched, featuring the use of Samsung’s micro-LED modules. Samsung also introduced a refrigerator and TV with Smart Hub in real time.
(Photo Description: ‘Flip’, smart whiteboard that can be interlocked with Smartphone via NFC)

‘Flip’ that Samsung presented lastly in a grand manner is a smart whiteboard and it can switch on and edit the content on the spot by interlocking with the smart phone via NFC. This product will be launched in January.

CES, the world’s largest IT exhibition, is an exhibition of trends in the global consumer electronics industry, held annually in January by the American Consumer Technology Association (CTA). Aving News reported the most issues of CES, MWC, and IFA, which are world's top three tech exhibitions, during last 11 years. It is sending special reporters to CES for this year as well; reporting major issues in the world market and introduce Korea's major companies all over the world.
